parsed.internal_thinking: Hadar is offering 1 sheep for 1 wheat. Looking at my resources, I have 5 wheat and 2 sheep. I need ore to build a city. While wheat is abundant for me (I just got more from the 9 roll on Hex 18), giving wheat to Hadar helps her since I'm currently blocking her other wheat source (Hex 14) with the robber. However, I have an excess of wheat and sheep isn't my priority—ore is. Accepting this doesn't get me closer to a city and helps my main rival bypass the block I put on her. I'll reject and try to push for ore instead.
parsed.note_to_self: Rejected Hadar's sheep for wheat. I have 5 wheat and need ore for a city. Giving her wheat now undermines the robber block on Hex 14.
parsed.say_outloud: הדר, יש לי כבר מספיק כבשים וחיטה זה בערך הדבר היחיד שזז פה כרגע. אם יש לך אבן לדבר עליה, זה כבר סיפור אחר.
